command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Show ON/OFF");if(!b)throw new Error("Show ON/OFF missing: "+document.body.innerText.slice(-600));if(b.disabled)throw new Error("Show ON/OFF disabled");b.click();return true})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);ws.close();}}' && sleep 3; PRESET=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 'http://192.168.0.16/rpc/PLUGS_UI.GetConfig'); echo LED_PRESET=$PRESET; PRESET="$PRESET" python3 -c 'import json,os; d=json.loads(os.environ["PRESET"])["leds"]; assert d["mode"]=="switch"; c=d["colors"]["switch:0"]; assert c["on"]["rgb"]==[0,100,0] and c["on"]["brightness"]==100; assert c["off"]["rgb"]==[100,0,0] and c["off"]["brightness"]==100'
